items.note: Paramaras chose the Bhumija as favoured mode, with vertical chains of kuta-stambhas; three imperial monuments among two dozen surviving temples.
Malava has been seen as the homeland of the Bhumija, though equally prevalent in Seunadesha.

claim.value: Malava seen as homeland; equally prevalent in Seunadesha

items.note: Remnants of the destroyed Bijamandal at Vidisha (c late 11th century) on a gigantic scale.

claim.value: invented as a transformation of the Latina; specialist guilds

items.note: Deccani flavour: onion gavakshas on bhadras, cushion pillars, curvaceous mouldings; shared traits with Karnataka Dravida temples.
